ana_docs: Dropped a compact changelog entry for the routing and SDK parity fixes into `releases/snippet-parity` branch. Need quick SDK check + anchor sweep before localization.

lee_sdk: Sending corrected snippets now. JS should use `client.completions.create`, Python the stream API, and avoid `prompt` keyword.

chris_pm: Can we add a single Known Issues bullet about transient embedding staleness after failover? Keep it user-facing and short.

ana_docs: (typo) I meant ana_docs: Added a one-line Known Issues note: "Embeddings may appear stale for a few minutes after failover; reindexing is automatic."

link-bot: link-scan: /docs/regions/apac => 302 -> /docs/regions/ap-southeast (update to canonical). /docs/dedicated/configuration#pinning => OK.

ana_docs: (typo again) I fixed the earlier typo in the draft and swapped APAC links to `/docs/regions/ap-southeast`. Pushed PR #5601 with small JS/Python/Go snippet edits and anchor fixes. Front-matter set `unrelease: true`.

lee_sdk: Quick nit: use `output_text` consistently in JS examples to keep things brief.

chris_pm: LGTM after that tiny change. I'll schedule the announcement once we flip `unrelease` at publish time.

ana_docs: Thanks, closing thread. Please drop a :eyes: or :shipit: on PR #5601.
